dimensionsMm.assignmentBasis: GIGABYTE prints a two-figure board outline in centimetres, recorded here in millimetres as the board's two in-plane dimensions. thicknessMm is absent because the Rev. 1.3 page publishes no board thickness; it is not filled from the Micro-ATX form factor, which standardises mounting geometry rather than this SKU's physical dimensions.

notes: Published facts with no cat6 or compat2 field, kept verbatim rather than dropped; all from source.cat6.gigabyte.b650m-aorus-elite-ax-rev-1-3.spec. Revision: this SKU is the Rev. 1.3 board and its figures come from the Rev. 1.3 specification page. GIGABYTE publishes revision-specific pages under one model name, so figures from the 1.0/1.1, 1.2 or 1.4 pages do not transfer here; the revision is carried in both the id and modelName for that reason. Memory: 4 DIMM sockets, maximum capacity 256GB, AMD EXPO and Intel XMP supported. maxMemorySpeedMtS records DDR5-8000(OC), the highest rate the vendor explicitly lists for this SKU, per C14. BIOS: biosMinVersionForCpu is deliberately empty under O6.

evidence.basis: Visual footprint 244 × 244 mm from authored dimensionsMm (lengthMm → X, heightMm → Z). Motherboard thickness is not published for this SKU and is not represented — the visual mesh is a zero-thickness XZ plane with no Y extent. Anchor and socket node positions mirror the project-authored hand-placed mounting semantics of motherboard.gigabyte-b650-aorus-elite-ax-v2; they are not manufacturer-verified geometry.
